title: Pearl rails
features:
# Pearl Hub | Dead Rails



## Combat

- **Aimbot / Camera Lock**: locks onto mobs or players, with adjustable FOV, smoothness, wall check and aim part

- **Auto Hit**: swings your melee at anything in reach

- **Kill Aura**: hits every mob around you, in any direction

- **Gun Aura**: automatically shoots the closest mob in clear view

- **Train Kill Aura**: takes out anything that gets near your train

- **Smart Weapon Switch**: always holds the gun or melee that can actually do damage



## Farming & Automation

- **Auto Bond Farm**: drives the train and collects every bond along the way

- **Loop Runs**: when a run ends, returns to the lobby, starts a new solo party and farms again

- **Auto Farm**: loots valuables into your sack and sells them at every town

- **Auto Collect / Auto Sack / Grab Money Bags**

- **Auto Sell**: empties your sack at any counter

- **Auto Fuel Train**: burns junk and buys coal when you run low

- **Auto Drive Train**

- **Auto Heal**: uses snake oil and bandages when your health drops

- **Safety System**: retreats to the train when hurt or swarmed, and plays it safe at night



## Visuals

- **Player ESP / NPC ESP / Mob ESP**: name, health and distance

- **Fullbright**

- **Light Sphere**



## Movement & Teleports

- **Noclip**

- **Fly (Chair)** *(beta)*

- **Teleports**: Train, Horse, every Town, Sterling, Stillwater Prison, Tesla Lab, Merchants, Forts and Outposts



## Utilities

- **Bring Items**: valuables, guns, ammo, medical, armor, fuel and explosives

- **Bring Cannon**: to you or to your train

- **Instant Interact**

- **Bank Codes Reveal**: finds the vault combo pieces and notes

- **Unlock Camera**: third person with free zoom

- **Draggable Panel**: live money, bonds, fuel, speed and sack



Clean interface | Settings save automatically | Mobile support
